title: BlocksReadParams
description: Params of the blocks.read agent tool: read a window of ONE finished block's output, addressed by the id blocks.list gave. The window is explicit and the reply states the total and the window it actually returned, so a window past the end of the output is answered honestly rather than as an error (design §4.4). List first: the total tells you where to aim, and a question about the end of a long output is answered by asking for the end. The block the tool may read is bounded by the grant's session scopes, enforced by the narrowed capability (ADR-0028 decision 4): an id from any other session is refused whether or not it exists. The model is untrusted input and gets the same check the renderer's parameters get: additionalProperties false plus an explicit required list.

sessionId.description: The session the block belongs to, inside the grant's session scopes.

blockId.description: The block to read, exactly as blocks.list spelled its id.

start.description: First output line of the window, 0-based and inclusive. Absent: 0.

count.description: How many lines the window asks for. Absent: 200. Fewer are returned when the block ends first or the text would exceed the tool's byte bound, and the reply says which window it returned.
